info.name: Online Course Platform Backend API
info.description:
REST API for Online Course Platform - Phase 0 Foundation

**Status**: Phase 0 (Foundation)
- ✅ Health Check endpoint implemented
- 🟨 Other endpoints ready for Phase 1+ implementation

**Base URL**: http://localhost:5000/api

**Authentication**: JWT Token (except /auth/register, /auth/login, /health)

request.description:
Check server health status

**Status**: ✅ IMPLEMENTED

**Expected Response** (200 OK):
```json
{
  "status": "ok",
  "timestamp": "2026-03-29T10:30:45.123Z",
  "uptime": 125.456
}
```

Register a new user account (Instructor or Student)

**Status**: 🟨 READY FOR PHASE 1 IMPLEMENTATION

**Authorization**: None (public endpoint)

**Request Body**:
```json
{
  "name": "string (2-100 chars, required)",
  "email": "string (valid email, required, unique)",
  "password": "string (min 8 chars, required)",
  "role": "enum: 'Instructor' | 'Student' (required)"
}
```

**Expected Response** (201 Created):
```json
{
  "success": true,
  "message": "User registered successfully",
  "data": {
    "id": "507f1f77bcf86cd799439011",
    "name": "Ahmed Hassan",
    "email": "ahmed@example.com",
    "role": "Student",
    "createdAt": "2026-03-29T10:30:45.123Z"
  },
  "token": "eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9..."
}
```

Authenticate user and receive JWT token

**Status**: 🟨 READY FOR PHASE 1 IMPLEMENTATION

**Authorization**: None (public endpoint)

**Request Body**:
```json
{
  "email": "string (valid email, required)",
  "password": "string (required)"
}
```

**Expected Response** (200 OK):
```json
{
  "success": true,
  "message": "Login successful",
  "data": {
    "id": "507f1f77bcf86cd799439011",
    "name": "Ahmed Hassan",
    "email": "ahmed@example.com",
    "role": "Student"
  },
  "token": "eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9..."
}
```

Create a new course (Instructor only)

**Status**: 🟨 READY FOR PHASE 1 IMPLEMENTATION

**Authorization**: Bearer token required (Instructor role)

**Request Body**:
```json
{
  "title": "string (5-200 chars, required)",
  "description": "string (20-2000 chars, required)",
  "category": "string (optional)"
}
```

**Expected Response** (201 Created):
```json
{
  "success": true,
  "message": "Course created successfully",
  "data": {
    "_id": "507f1f77bcf86cd799439012",
    "title": "Introduction to Web Development",
    "description": "Learn the fundamentals...",
    "instructorId": "507f1f77bcf86cd799439011",
    "category": "Web Development",
    "createdAt": "2026-03-29T10:30:45.123Z",
    "updatedAt": "2026-03-29T10:30:45.123Z"
  }
}
```

Get list of all courses with pagination

**Status**: 🟨 READY FOR PHASE 1 IMPLEMENTATION

**Authorization**: Bearer token required

**Query Parameters**:
- `limit`: Number of results to return (default: 10)
- `offset`: Number of results to skip (default: 0)

**Expected Response** (200 OK):
```json
{
  "success": true,
  "data": [
    {
      "_id": "507f1f77bcf86cd799439012",
      "title": "Introduction to Web Development",
      "description": "Learn the fundamentals...",
      "instructorId": "507f1f77bcf86cd799439011",
      "category": "Web Development",
      "createdAt": "2026-03-29T10:30:45.123Z"
    }
  ],
  "pagination": {
    "limit": 10,
    "offset": 0,
    "total": 5
  }
}
```

Get detailed information about a specific course

**Status**: 🟨 READY FOR PHASE 1 IMPLEMENTATION

**Authorization**: Bearer token required

**URL Parameters**:
- `courseId`: Course ID (ObjectId)

**Expected Response** (200 OK):
```json
{
  "success": true,
  "data": {
    "_id": "507f1f77bcf86cd799439012",
    "title": "Introduction to Web Development",
    "description": "Learn the fundamentals...",
    "instructorId": "507f1f77bcf86cd799439011",
    "category": "Web Development",
    "createdAt": "2026-03-29T10:30:45.123Z",
    "updatedAt": "2026-03-29T10:30:45.123Z"
  }
}
```

Add a new lesson to a course (Instructor only)

**Status**: 🟨 READY FOR PHASE 1 IMPLEMENTATION

**Authorization**: Bearer token required (Instructor of course)

**URL Parameters**:
- `courseId`: Course ID (ObjectId)

**Request Body**:
```json
{
  "title": "string (required)",
  "content": "string (required)",
  "position": "number (lesson order, required)"
}
```

**Expected Response** (201 Created):
```json
{
  "success": true,
  "message": "Lesson created successfully",
  "data": {
    "_id": "507f1f77bcf86cd799439013",
    "title": "Introduction to HTML",
    "content": "HTML (HyperText Markup Language)...",
    "courseId": "507f1f77bcf86cd799439012",
    "position": 1,
    "createdAt": "2026-03-29T10:30:45.123Z"
  }
}
```

Get all lessons for a specific course

**Status**: 🟨 READY FOR PHASE 1 IMPLEMENTATION

**Authorization**: Bearer token required

**URL Parameters**:
- `courseId`: Course ID (ObjectId)

**Expected Response** (200 OK):
```json
{
  "success": true,
  "data": [
    {
      "_id": "507f1f77bcf86cd799439013",
      "title": "Introduction to HTML",
      "content": "HTML (HyperText Markup Language)...",
      "courseId": "507f1f77bcf86cd799439012",
      "position": 1,
      "createdAt": "2026-03-29T10:30:45.123Z"
    }
  ]
}
```

Enroll a student in a course (Student only)

**Status**: 🟨 READY FOR PHASE 1 IMPLEMENTATION

**Authorization**: Bearer token required (Student role)

**URL Parameters**:
- `courseId`: Course ID (ObjectId)

**Request Body**: Empty object
```json
{}
```

**Expected Response** (201 Created):
```json
{
  "success": true,
  "message": "Successfully enrolled in course",
  "data": {
    "_id": "507f1f77bcf86cd799439014",
    "studentId": "507f1f77bcf86cd799439015",
    "courseId": "507f1f77bcf86cd799439012",
    "enrolledAt": "2026-03-29T10:30:45.123Z",
    "progress": 0
  }
}
```

**Error Response** (409 Conflict):
```json
{
  "success": false,
  "error": "Student already enrolled in this course",
  "code": "ALREADY_ENROLLED"
}
```

Add a comment to a lesson (Student only)

**Status**: 🟨 READY FOR PHASE 1 IMPLEMENTATION

**Authorization**: Bearer token required (Student role)

**URL Parameters**:
- `lessonId`: Lesson ID (ObjectId)

**Request Body**:
```json
{
  "content": "string (required)"
}
```

**Expected Response** (201 Created):
```json
{
  "success": true,
  "message": "Comment added successfully",
  "data": {
    "_id": "507f1f77bcf86cd799439016",
    "content": "Great explanation! This really helped...",
    "studentId": "507f1f77bcf86cd799439015",
    "lessonId": "507f1f77bcf86cd799439013",
    "createdAt": "2026-03-29T10:30:45.123Z"
  }
}
```

Get all comments for a specific lesson

**Status**: 🟨 READY FOR PHASE 1 IMPLEMENTATION

**Authorization**: Bearer token required

**URL Parameters**:
- `lessonId`: Lesson ID (ObjectId)

**Query Parameters**:
- `limit`: Number of results to return (default: 20)
- `offset`: Number of results to skip (default: 0)

**Expected Response** (200 OK):
```json
{
  "success": true,
  "data": [
    {
      "_id": "507f1f77bcf86cd799439016",
      "content": "Great explanation! This really helped...",
      "studentId": "507f1f77bcf86cd799439015",
      "lessonId": "507f1f77bcf86cd799439013",
      "createdAt": "2026-03-29T10:30:45.123Z"
    }
  ],
  "pagination": {
    "limit": 20,
    "offset": 0,
    "total": 1
  }
}
```
